dst_properties.abstract: MCC: This is based on an earlier release WIC; however, it was decided to introduce the change in Rel-18. The mirror CR is in R1-2508193
dst_properties.consequencesIfNotApproved: No support for SSSG switching on SCells.
dst_properties.reasonForChange:
Clause 10.4 in TS 38.213 specifies that, when BWP switching occurs without receiving a DCI with the BWP indicator field, the UE starts monitoring search space sets with group index 0 in the new active DL BWP. These cases include,
Expiration of bwp-InactivityTimer,
RA procedure requested by higher layers, and
RRC configuration.
In the CA scenario, SCell activation with MAC CE can also trigger a new active BWP without DCI, which is not addressed in the cases above. To resolve ambiguity in determining the SSSG index for a newly activated SCell, SCell activation should be added to the list of BWP switching events without DCI.
dst_properties.secretaryRemarks: Source modified on 17/10/2025. Original source : Qualcomm Incorporated, Samsung
dst_properties.summaryOfChange: SCell activation is added as a case of BWP switching without DCI, necessitating a fallback to SSSG index 0.
dst_properties.title: Determination of SSSG index in a newly activated SCell

dst_properties.abstract: MCC: The mirror CR is in R1-2508136
dst_properties.consequencesIfNotApproved: UE is required to trigger non-frequency-hopping positioning SRS in a communication BWP and a frequency-hopping positioning SRS in the virtual BWP in the same DCI, which adds unnecessary UE complexity. In addition, the handling of BWP indicator in the DCI for frequency hopping SRS is not clear.
dst_properties.reasonForChange:
1. There exists ambiguity with respect to triggering aperiodic positioning SRS with frequency hopping (outside communication BWP) and triggering other aperiodic positioning SRS without frequency hopping (inside communication BWP).
2. For aperiodic positioning SRS with frequency hopping, the handling of the existing BWP ID in the DCI is not clear.
dst_properties.secretaryRemarks: Source modified on 16/10/2025. Original source : Huawei, HiSilicon, Ofinno, Samsung, ZTE Corporation, Sanechips
dst_properties.summaryOfChange:
1. Similar to RAN2 agreed RRC CR [R2- 2506305] on SP Positioning SRS, the restriction on aperiodic positioning SRS configuration is also added that UE does not expect to be configured with aperiodic positioning SRS with frequency hopping and aperiodic positioning SRS without frequency hopping.
2. Similar to the principle in RAN2 agreed MAC CR [R2-2506304] on SP Positioning SRS, UE shall ignore the BWP indicator in the DCI for AP Positioning SRS with frequency hopping.
dst_properties.title: Correction to aperiodic SRS with frequency hopping

dst_properties.abstract: MCC: The mirror CR is in R1-2508197
dst_properties.consequencesIfNotApproved: UE cannot generate the preamble for PRACH transmission occasion associated with an additional PCI correctly for 2TA operation.
dst_properties.reasonForChange:
In 38.331, for Rel-18 2TA operation, the higher-layer parameter prach-RootSequenceIndex in RACH-ConfigTwoTA is used to indicate PRACH root sequence index for PRACH transmission occasions associated with an additional PCI, this has not been captured in current 38.211. 
In 38.331, for Rel-18 2TA operation, the higher-layer parameter twoTA-restrictedSetConfig in RACH-ConfigTwoTA is used to configure an unrestricted set or one of two types of restricted sets for cyclic shifts generation of a PRACH transmission occasion associated with an additional PCI. This has not been captured in current 38.211.
dst_properties.summaryOfChange:
Clarify that the higher-layer parameter prach-RootSequenceIndex in RACH-ConfigTwoTA is used to indicate PRACH root sequence index for PRACH transmission occasion associated with an additional PCI.
Clarify that the higher-layer parameter twoTA-restrictedSetConfig in RACH-ConfigTwoTA is used to determine cyclic shift of a logical root sequence for PRACH transmission occasion associated with an additional PCI.
dst_properties.title: CR on determination of cyclic shift for PRACH transmission in 2TA

dst_properties.abstract: MCC: The mirror CR is in R1-2509564.
dst_properties.consequencesIfNotApproved: The specification on the number of UL PTRS ports is wrong.
dst_properties.reasonForChange:
In Rel-18, SDM based STxMP was introduced. For a UE supporting full coherent codebook, if it is not configured with SDM based STxMP (i.e., multipanelSchemeSDM), it can be configured with only one UL PTRS port. While if it is configured with SDM based STxMP (i.e., multipanelSchemeSDM), it can be configured with one or two UL PTRS ports.
However, according to current spec (i.e., the first sentence as below), for a UE supporting full coherent codebook, no matter multipanelSchemeSDM is configured or not, only one UL PTRS can be configured. The condition that UE is not configured with multipanelSchemeSDM is missed.
In addition, according to the second sentence, when multipanelSchemeSDM is configured, the max number of UL PTRS can only be configured to 2 by maxNrofPorts-SDM. This is incorrect since the candidate value of maxNrofPorts-SDM includes n1 and n2.
dst_properties.secretaryRemarks: Source modified on 21/11/2025. Original source : Huawei, Hisilicon, ZTE, Samsung
dst_properties.summaryOfChange:
Refine the condition under which only one UL PTRS port can be configured.
Change ‘n2’ to ‘n1 or n2’
dst_properties.title: Correction on the condition for the number of UL PTRS ports in 38.214

dst_properties.abstract: MCC: The mirror CR is in R1-2509571.
dst_properties.consequencesIfNotApproved: Current description would cause wrong UE behavior when nrofSRS-Ports-n8 is set to ports8tdm for an SRS resource.
dst_properties.reasonForChange:
Till Rel-18, all SRS port(s) of an SRS resource are mapped to each symbol of the resource. However, in Rel-18, TDMed SRS port mapping is supported for 8-port SRS resource. When the RRC parameter nrofSRS-Ports-n8 is set to ports8 for an SRS resource, all the 8 SRS ports are mapped to each (S = 1) symbol of the resource. While when RRC parameter nrofSRS-Ports-n8 is set to ports8tdm for an SRS resource, the 8 SRS port(s) are mapped to every S = 2 symbols of the resource in a TDM manner.
In clause 6.4.1.4 of TS 38.211, the TDM SRS port mapping scheme is clearly specified. However, current description in clause 6.2.1 of TS 38.214 does NOT capture the case where 8 SRS ports in an SRS resource are mapped to every S = 2 symbols of the resource.
dst_properties.secretaryRemarks: Source modified on 21/11/2025. Original source : ZTE Corporation, Sanechips, Samsung
dst_properties.summaryOfChange: Clarify that SRS port(s) of an SRS resource are mapped to every S symbol(s) of the resource according to clause 6.4.1.4 of TS 38.211.
dst_properties.title: CR on SRS port(s) mapping on OFDM symbol(s)

dst_properties.abstract: MCC: The mirror CR is in R1-2509597.
dst_properties.consequencesIfNotApproved: The specification leads to misunderstanding that two SRIs can be indicated when codepoint "00" or "01" of SRS Resource Set indicator is indicated.
dst_properties.reasonForChange:
For non-codebook PUSCH when multipanelSchemeSFN is configured and when codepoint "00" or "01" of SRS Resource Set indicator is indicated, only one SRI is indicated. However, UE behavior when two SRIs are indicated is captured in current specification for the case when codepoint "00" or "01" of SRS Resource Set indicator is indicated. 
The current description should be aplicable only when codepoint “10”.
dst_properties.summaryOfChange:
For non-codebook PUSCH when multipanelSchemeSFN is configured and when codepoint "00" or "01" of SRS Resource Set indicator is indicated, remove description of UE behavior when two SRIs are indicated for the case when codepoint "00" or "01" of SRS Resource Set indicator is indicated, in order to make sure that UE does not expect to be indicated with two SRIs in this case.
The current description is applicable only when codepoint “10”.
dst_properties.title: CR on SRI in STxMP SFN non-codebook PUSCH

dst_properties.abstract: MCC: The mirror Rel-19 CR is in R1-2509604.
dst_properties.consequencesIfNotApproved: RACH-less handover for mobile IAB or TN can not be supported by RAN1 specification. RAN1 and RAN2 specifications are not consistent.
dst_properties.reasonForChange:
Firstly, based on the LS R1-2505120, the RACH-less handover applies to NTN UEs and TN UEs (including UEs on mobile IAB). However, in current RAN1 specifications, the description of RACH-less handover is only applicable for the NTN. It cannot be applied to the RACH-less handover in mIAB and TN.
In addition, the mIAB and TN can also be applicable in TDD bands, the PO validation behaviour in TDD band for RACH-less handover is needed.
Secondly, for power control, the downlink pathloss estimate for RACH-less handover is determined only using a RS resource from the SSB index provided by RACH-lessHO, which cannot support the case where the pathloss is estimated based on a RS indicated via the TCI state for TN and mobile-IAB.
dst_properties.secretaryRemarks: Source modified on 21/11/2025. Original source : NEC, vivo, Samsung, Ericsson
dst_properties.summaryOfChange:
Add descriptions for the case that an RS configured by a TC state is provided for power control in clause 7.1.1.
Remove the “ NTN” in “22 PUSCH transmission in NTN RACH-less handover” to cover the PUSCH transmission procedure in both NTN and TN (including mobile IAB) RACH-less handover.
Add the description in case the tci-StateID is provided in RACH-LessHO in clause “22.2 Dynamic-grant PUSCH transmission”
Add the description of PO validation in TDD band for RACH-less handover, and add the case that an RS configured by a TC state is provided for power determination in clause 22.1.
